instruction: How to notify via Slack on cert renewal
output: certbot renew --deploy-hook 'curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"text\":\"Cert renewed for example.com\"}" https://hooks.slack.com/services/xxx'

instruction: How to create a custom renewal script
output: echo '#!/bin/bash' > /usr/local/bin/cert-renew.sh && echo 'certbot renew --quiet --post-hook "systemctl reload nginx"' >> /usr/local/bin/cert-renew.sh && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cert-renew.sh

instruction: How to run a custom renewal script daily
How to create a certbot renewal wrapper for multiple services
output: echo '#!/bin/bash' > /usr/local/bin/cert-renew-all.sh && echo 'certbot renew --quiet --post-hook "systemctl reload nginx; systemctl reload postfix; systemctl reload dovecot"' >> /usr/local/bin/cert-renew-all.sh && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cert-renew-all.sh
